PRIVACY NOTICE
PeddleNet — community test (Tier C)
This notice explains what personal data PeddleNet processes in the beta and your rights. Controller: Bill Costello / [PeddleNet entity] · Contact: th3p3ddl3r@gmail.com.
1. Our privacy principle

PeddleNet is designed to be anonymous by default. You are shown to others only by a display name you choose (which can be a pseudonym); we do not require your real name, phone number, or email to use the beta.
2. What we process
Display name (self-chosen) and a cryptographic device/node identity used to sign and route messages.
Room membership and presence signals — that you are active in a room, and approximate proximity derived from Bluetooth signal strength (not precise GPS).
Message content — created, transmitted, relayed across other devices/anchors, stored locally on devices, and briefly queued on a server for delivery.
Optional location — only if you enable a feature that uses it (e.g., a friend compass); off by default.
Technical/diagnostic data — connection quality, delivery success, and error logs used to make the network reliable.
3. Why, and our legal basis (GDPR)
To operate the Service — deliver and relay messages, show presence/rosters: performance of the terms you accept (contract), and our legitimate interest in a working network.
For the test, diagnostics, and any optional location features: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
4. How the mesh shares data — by design

PeddleNet is a mesh: to reach their destination, your messages pass through other participants' devices and anchors, signed for authenticity. A server backbone may process messages to bridge or queue them for delivery. We do not sell your personal data, and we do not share it with advertisers.
5. Aggregate analytics

We may compute aggregate, anonymized crowd metrics (for example, how busy an area is). In the beta these are aggregate-only and are not sold. If we ever intend to share or monetize any such data, we will update this notice, obtain any required consent, and offer applicable opt-outs first.
6. Retention

Messages live on participating devices and in a short-lived server delivery queue (pending items expire, e.g., within [24 hours]). Presence signals are ephemeral. Diagnostic logs are kept only as long as needed for the test and then deleted or anonymized.
7. Security — and an important limit

Messages are cryptographically signed so recipients can verify who sent them. However, message contents are NOT end-to-end encrypted in the beta, and "private" rooms are code-gated access, not encryption. Please do not send confidential or sensitive information through the Service.
8. Your rights

Depending on where you live (e.g., EU/UK under GDPR, California under CCPA), you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or port your data, to withdraw consent, to object to or restrict processing, and to opt out of any "sale" or "sharing" (we do neither). To exercise them, email [th3p3ddl3r@gmail.com]. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority.
9. Children
The beta is for users 18 and older; we do not knowingly process data from children.
10. International transfers & changes

The server backbone may process data in [server region]; where required we use appropriate safeguards for international transfers. We may update this notice for the beta; the current version is dated below.
